meta.note: XP table values are server-side. The client receives experienceToNextLevel from API. The s5t diminishing-returns formula with UK=80, E0=60 thresholds shapes the XP curve. Base array fzt=[40..100] mapped through s5t yields the chart curve. Actual XP amounts may be these values scaled by a server-side multiplier.

xpFormula.description: Diminishing returns applied to base XP values
xpFormula.chartCurveNote: The curve shows the relative XP requirements across levels 0-60. Levels 0-20 use flat base (40-60). Levels 21-40 use half-slope diminishing returns. Levels 41-60 use quarter-slope. Actual server-side XP amounts are scaled from these values.

levelThresholds.description: Level ranges and what unlocks at each tier. Source: z9 array in entry.js

capabilityUnlocks.description: What each capability does and when it unlocks

contracts.description: Ability to use contracts (incoming/outgoing supply agreements)

bonds.description: Ability to issue and trade bonds

executives.description: Ability to hire executives (COO, CFO, CMO, CTO)

buildingAuctions.description: Ability to participate in building auctions

buyOrders.description: Ability to place buy orders on the exchange

levelUpRewards.description: Rewards given upon reaching each level

productionSalesBonus.description: Every 5 levels (5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35, 40, 45, 50, 55, 60): +1% production OR sales speed bonus (player chooses specialization)
productionSalesBonus.sourceComment: From patch notes: 'Production/Sales bonus every 5th level' and 'You can choose to increase your production or sales speed when you achieve level 5, 10, 15, and so on.'

levelUpRewards.titleChanges: Company title changes at levels 0, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35, 40, 45, 50, 55, 60 (see levelThresholds.tiers)
levelUpRewards.maxBuildingsIncrease: Gradually increases from 4 (L0) to 14 (L30). Caps at 14 buildings.
levelUpRewards.timeLimitIncrease: Production/retail queue time limit increases from 2h (L0) to 24h (L5) to 48h (L15+)

xpEarningActions.description: Known actions that award XP (from code + patch notes)

actions.description: Using simboosts to rush building construction awards experience points
actions.evidence: Patch note: 'Fix bug when not all experience points were given on construction rush' (chunk_I6i.js:3635)
Patch note: 'Contest winners now receive 40,000 XP' (chunk_I6i.js:9667)

actions.description: Other contest certificate recipients receive 5,000 XP
actions.evidence: Patch note: 'other contest certificate recipients receive 5,000 XP' (chunk_I6i.js:9667)

actions.description: Building, producing, selling, and other economic activities grant XP. Exact amounts are server-side.
actions.evidence: Home page text: 'Companies are rewarded for employing people, building infrastructure, making profits off the market and other activities.'

actions.description: Executives gain experience separately (not player level XP). Based on time spent in position. Apprentice executives contribute at reduced rate.
actions.evidence: Multiple references to executive experience gain in patch notes and UI strings

levelInfoStructure.description: Shape of the levelInfo object returned by the API (api_v3_companies_auth_data)

fields.experience: number  — current XP accumulated in this level
fields.experienceToNextLevel: number  — total XP needed to reach next level
fields.inTutorial: boolean — whether player is in tutorial realm

acceleration.multiplier: number  — production speed acceleration multiplier (from simboosts/events)

fields.timeLimit: number  — max production/retail queue duration in seconds
fields.maxBuildings: number  — max number of building slots
fields.ratingCode: string  — bond credit rating code (tied to company financials)

tutorialLevels.description: Tutorial realm (realm 0) uses Gor array with an additional tier at start: -102
tutorialLevels.note: Tutorial realm has a -102 tier with only 2 maxBuildings and no capabilities, transitioning to the normal z9 table at level 0.

relevantChunks.chunk_FOr.js: Redux reducer for user state. Contains levelInfo update action (UPDATE_LEVEL_INFO), initial state with levelInfo: undefined, and fetch user data thunk (FETCH_USER_DATA / ADD_USER_DATA).
relevantChunks.chunk_rBn_2.js: Level/XP progress bar component. Reads levelInfo.experience and levelInfo.experienceToNextLevel to render the XP bar.
relevantChunks.chunk_VRt.js: Contains sJr(companyId, specialization) — the API call to apply level-up production/sales bonus.
relevantChunks.chunk_s5t.js: Contains s5t(t) — the diminishing returns formula used for XP and executive skill curves.
relevantChunks.entry.js:4009-4244: z9 array — the full level threshold table (13 tiers, 0-60).
relevantChunks.entry.js:4245-4364: Gor array — tutorial realm level thresholds.
relevantChunks.entry.js:57293-57296: fzt base values [40..100] and Wpi mapped XP curve via s5t.
relevantChunks.entry.js:3989-3990: E0=60, UK=80 — diminishing returns cutoff constants.
relevantChunks.chunk_DKn_2.js: Achievements UI component (not directly XP-related, but reads level for unlock display).
